title: Quick Grilled Ethiopian Lamb Bisque
description: A fresh and pillowy brunch dish featuring chopped parsley, robata-grill, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients. Serve in a molcajete for a unique presentation.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.notes: Fresh parsley is a must for this dish.

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium broth to control the salt content.

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.notes: Greek yogurt is a good substitute if you can't find traditional Ethiopian yogurt.

instructions: Preheat a robata grill to medium-high heat.
Season the lamb with salt, black pepper, paprika, and red pepper flakes.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a molcajete, combine the parsley, garlic, ginger, and gluten-free flour.
Add the chicken broth to the molcajete and whisk until smooth.
Add the yogurt and whisk until well combined.
Add the sliced lamb to the molcajete and stir to combine.
Add the clarified butter and stir to combine.
Season the bisque with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the bisque hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
